regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, graphical abstract, and publication metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current Pd/Brønsted-acid dehydrative coupling class. The graphical abstract is an aggregate generic reaction and reports 36 examples/up to 95%, not an additional experiment.
Classified the Horner-Mark [2,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement as cited prior literature; generic structures and no experiment-specific yield remain unresolved.
Classified transition-metal coupling of propargylic derivatives bearing generic leaving groups as a prior-work class, not a present-paper run.
Recorded the five printed high-temperature Lewis-acid condition sets as one prior-literature comparison record. No cited condition was promoted to a current-paper experiment.
Classified the Pd(PPh3)4/DPEphos/(PhO)2POOH/DCM room-temperature arrow as the current generic transformation; concrete rows are recorded from Table 1 and Scheme 2.

unresolved: Generic R/Ar/LG structures do not define unique molecules or experiment-specific outcomes.
The publisher SI link does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-16, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all sixteen optimization/control rows independently with 1a/2a charges, row Pd identity/loading, DPEphos/acid omissions, solvent volume, N2, 16 h, row temperature, crude-1H-NMR product yield, and starting-material recovery. The >99% recovery bound remains bounded.

Mapped catalyst, temperature, solvent, and control conclusions to the existing Table 1 rows without narrative duplicates. Entry 15's blank Pd cell plus superscript-d no-DPEphos ambiguity is retained rather than silently repaired.

regions.region: page 2 lower/right Scheme 2 scope discussion and gram-scale lead-in
regions.finding: Linked prose substrate classes, 3pa/3ac/3ae recovery statements, X-ray assignment of 3Aa, and 3aa scale-up lead-in to the page-3 records. No prose-only duplicate was created.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 15 visually has no Pd and carries footnote d (without DPEphos), while prose identifies it as the palladium control; both source cues remain unresolved.
Table 1 omits workup, purification, mass, and recovery analytical basis; Scheme 2 yield basis is not stated.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 reaction header, 36 product arrows, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all 36 distinct scope rows (3aa through 3wf), each with displayed product yield/time, shared charge/loadings/solvent/Ar/r.t. conditions, footnote b/c/d overrides, and product-specific 1a/1p recovery where printed. CCDC 2366046 is linked to 3Aa as characterization.
Recorded the independent 4.0 mmol/27 h 3aa scale-up (94%, 1.4515 g), the 40 min MeCN/H2O/air PhSeCl transformation to (E)-5 (85%), and the 14 h THF/air CuBr2 transformation to (E)-6 (81%).

Recorded separate Pd(PPh3)4-loading and (PhO)2POOH-loading kinetic series with displayed x-values, regressions, R2, M/min rate axis, and first-order conclusions. Individual rate points were not estimated from the plot.
Linked the acid/Pd control interpretation and proposed oxonium/allenyl-Pd/ligand-exchange/reductive-elimination pathway to Scheme 5 on page 4; proposed species were not treated as preparations.

unresolved: Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 do not explicitly state yield measurement/isolation bases or workup/purification details.
Kinetic panels omit exact rate values, errors, and complete operating details.

regions.finding: Classified I-III and P(III)/P(V) tautomerization as a proposed catalytic cycle, not independent preparations or measured intermediates.
